summary.headline: Māshāʾallāh’s Three Astrological Books
summary.text: Title page for Māshāʾallāh’s three astrological books: the Revolution of the Years of the World, planetary significations in nativities, and Reception. Dedicated to Georg Ernst, Count of Henneberg, edited by Joachim Heller, and printed at Nuremberg in 1549.
